title: CycleGAN Unpaired Ring-to-Square Constellation Translation
intuition: Simultaneously trains dual translators (G_XY, G_YX) and dual critics (D_Y, D_X) for unpaired domain translation between an 8-mode circular ring and an 8-mode square perimeter, verifying bidirectional coverage and cycle RMSE <= 0.12.
failure_mode: Dual minimax loops decouple or collapse multiple source modes onto a single target mode, breaking cycle-consistency or losing target coverage in one direction.
